terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These Terms of Use ("Terms") apply to all services provided by SofinHub, including the website, courses, communities and related features (collectively, the "Service"). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to comply with the terms below.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
s1.p1: By accessing or using SofinHub, you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these Terms together with our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>. If you do not agree, please stop using the Service.

s2.title: 2. User accounts
s2.li1: You must provide accurate information when registering (full name, email) and keep it up to date when it changes.
s2.li2: You are responsible for keeping your password secure and for all activity under your account.
s2.li3: Notify us immediately if you discover unauthorized access to your account.
s2.li4: The Service is intended for people aged 16 and over; those under 16 need the consent of a parent or guardian.

s3.title: 3. Courses and content
s3.p1: When you join a paid course or community, you are granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable right to access the content for personal learning purposes. You may not copy, redistribute, sell or publicly share course content without the written permission of SofinHub or the instructor who owns that content.

s4.title: 4. Payments, trials and cancellation
s4.li1: Some courses and communities are charged monthly, with the price clearly shown before you join.
s4.li2: If a free trial is offered, its length and conditions are stated on the course page.
s4.li3: You can cancel your plan at any time; cancellation takes effect from the next billing cycle unless the law provides otherwise.
s4.li4: We are not responsible for transactions that result from you disclosing your login or payment information.

s5.title: 5. Community code of conduct
s5.p1: When joining communities, commenting or posting on SofinHub, you agree not to:
s5.li1: Post content that is unlawful, abusive, harassing, discriminatory or fraudulent;
s5.li2: Impersonate another person or organization or spread false information;
s5.li3: Spam, advertise without permission or collect other members' data without authorization;
s5.li4: Deliberately disrupt or damage the Service's systems or security.
s5.p2: We reserve the right to remove violating content and to suspend or terminate the related accounts.

s6.title: 6. Intellectual property
s6.p1: All brands, interfaces, source code and content created by SofinHub are owned by SofinHub or its licensors. Course content provided by instructors or partners is owned by them and licensed for use through SofinHub.

s7.title: 7. Suspension and termination
s7.p1: We may suspend or terminate your access if you violate these Terms. You may also stop using the Service and request deletion of your account at any time.

s8.title: 8. Limitation of liability
s8.p1: The Service is provided on an "as is" basis. To the extent permitted by law, SofinHub is not liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, the Service.

s9.title: 9. Changes to these terms
s9.p1: We may update these Terms from time to time. The new version takes effect once it is posted on this page; continuing to use the Service after an update means you accept the changes.

s10.title: 10. Contact
s10.p1: If you have any questions about these Terms of Use, please contact the SofinHub team by email at <mail>support@sofinhub.com</mail>.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how SofinHub collects, uses, shares and protects your personal information when you use our website, courses and communities.

s1.title: 1. Information we collect
s1.li1: Account information: full name, email, password (encrypted/hashed, never stored in plain text).
s1.li2: Usage information: courses joined, learning progress, interactions in communities.
s1.li3: Device information: IP address, browser type, access times, used for security and to improve the service.
s1.li4: Payment information: processed by our payment gateway partner; SofinHub does not store full card numbers.

s2.title: 2. How we use your information
s2.li1: Creating and maintaining accounts, authenticating logins, recovering passwords;
s2.li2: Providing, personalizing and improving course and community content;
s2.li3: Processing payments, memberships and related notifications;
s2.li4: Sending updates, newsletters (if you subscribe) and providing customer support;
s2.li5: Detecting and preventing fraud and abuse, and keeping our systems safe.

s3.title: 3. Cookies and tracking technologies
s3.p1: We use cookies and similar technologies to keep you logged in, remember your preferences and analyze traffic. You can disable cookies in your browser, but some features (such as staying logged in) may not work fully.

s4.title: 4. Sharing information with third parties
s4.p1: We do not sell your personal information. Information is only shared in the following cases:
s4.li1: With payment processing partners to complete transactions;
s4.li2: With technical infrastructure providers (hosting, email delivery) under confidentiality agreements;
s4.li3: When required by law or to protect the legitimate rights of SofinHub and its users.

s5.title: 5. Data security
s5.p1: Passwords are hashed before storage, connections are encrypted over HTTPS, and sessions use short-lived access tokens with a secure token refresh mechanism. Even with reasonable safeguards, no system is completely secure — please protect your password and tell us if you suspect your account has been compromised.

s6.title: 6. Data retention
s6.p1: We keep your account information for as long as you use the Service. When you request account deletion, your personal data will be deleted or anonymized within a reasonable time, unless the law requires us to retain it for longer.

s7.title: 7. Your rights
s7.li1: Access and review the personal information you have provided;
s7.li3: Request deletion of your account and related data;
s7.li4: Withdraw your consent to receive newsletters or marketing emails at any time.
s7.p1: To exercise these rights, please get in touch using the "Contact" section below.

s8.title: 8. Who may use the Service
s8.p1: The Service is not directed at children under 13. If you discover that an account for a child under 13 was created without parental consent, please contact us so we can deal with it.

s9.title: 9. Changes to this policy
s9.p1: This policy may be updated from time to time. The most recent update date is shown at the top of the page. We encourage you to review it periodically.

s10.title: 10. Contact
s10.p1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact <mail>support@sofinhub.com</mail>. See also our <terms>Terms of Use</terms>.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Can't find an answer? Contact us at <mail>support@sofinhub.com</mail>.
faq.teamReady: The SofinHub team is always ready to help.
faq.seeMore: See also our <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

account.title: Account & Login
account.a0: Click "Sign up", or click "Join now" on a community while logged out. You need to read the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy all the way through (scroll to the bottom of the page) before ticking the agreement box. After you sign up, we send you an email to verify your address.
account.a1: At least 8 characters, including at least 1 uppercase letter and 1 special character (e.g. Password@123).
account.q2: What if I forget my password?
account.a2: On the Login page, click "Forgot password" and enter your email. We email you a password reset link; the link expires and can only be used once. You can also change your password at any time in Account Settings.
account.q3: Can I log in with Google/Facebook?
account.a3: Not yet. For now you log in with your email and password.
account.q4: How do I log out or manage my personal information?
account.a4: Click your name in the top-right corner of the header: there you will find Profile, Account Settings (change your details, password and signed-in devices), Notifications, Messages, Plans & billing and the "Log out" button.

community.title: Communities
community.q0: How do I join a community?
community.a0: Open the community's detail page and click "Join now". If you are not logged in, you are taken to the login page and then brought back to that community. Paid communities send you to the checkout page; private communities require an admin to approve your request.
community.q1: What can I do in a community?
community.a1: Post and comment on the Discussion page, learn in the Classroom (modules, lessons, progress tracking), view the Events calendar, see Members and the points Leaderboard, and leave a review for the community.
community.q2: Can I create my own community?
community.a2: Yes. Click "Create community" in the header and fill in the name, description, category, public/private mode and price (free or paid). You become the community owner and can build the Classroom, create events, moderate content, invite admins/moderators and view revenue.
community.q3: How do I leave a community?
community.a3: Go back to the community's detail page and click the "Joined" button to leave. For paid communities, you lose access immediately and the plan automatically cancels at the end of the period (you will not be charged for the next period, and the amount already paid is not refunded); within the paid period you can rejoin at no extra cost. Check the status under "Plans & billing".
community.q4: Where do I report violating content or members?
community.a4: Use the "Report" function on a post or comment. Community admins handle reports on the Moderation page, and the platform admin team can step in when needed.

billing.title: Payments & Memberships
billing.q0: How does payment for paid communities work?
billing.a0: Paid communities are billed on a monthly plan. You pay on that community's checkout page; the price is clearly shown on the detail page. Your transactions and plans are under "Plans & billing".
billing.a1: Paid communities offer a free trial period; the exact number of days is shown on the community detail page and may change depending on platform settings.
billing.q2: Can I cancel my plan at any time?
billing.a2: Yes. You cancel under "Plans & billing"; your access remains until the end of the period you have paid for and you will not be charged again.
billing.a3: Yes, within the platform's refund window. Contact support with your transaction details; your request will be reviewed and the invoice will show the "Refunded" status once it is complete.

support.title: Support
support.a0: Submit the form on the Contact page or email support@sofinhub.com. Your request is logged as a support ticket and our team replies by email.
support.q1: Is my personal data kept secure?
support.a1: See the Privacy Policy page for details on how we collect, use and protect data.
